name: roma
description: Roma for Claude Code: the server and the skill in one plugin

plugins.name: roma
plugins.description: Roma gives your AI chat a place to keep things. Ask it to save a plan as a note, add tasks to a list, or fill a list of books, contacts or expenses, and it is still there tomorrow, in this chat or any other. Start a conversation and it can see where you are: what's due today, what you're working on, recent notes, your lists, and what you asked Roma to remember about you.
